# Benchmark results (generated by benchmarks/bench.py)

- Machine: arm64 / Darwin 25.6.0; Python 3.11.1
- Libraries: numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pandas 3.0.6, scikit-learn 1.9.1, matplotlib 3.11.2, jinja2 3.1.6, pydantic 2.14.1, typer 0.27.3, rich 15.0.0
- Configuration: 2 probability columns on the same rows, uniform 10 bins, binning sensitivity on (5/10/20 × uniform/quantile), paired comparison; bootstrap 2000 percentile replicates of Brier, log loss, mean error and paired differences; default batch budget 4,000,000 index elements.
- Timing: best of 3 untraced runs (bootstrap at 1,000,000 rows: 1 run), time.perf_counter. Memory: one separate run under tracemalloc (peak of traced NumPy/Python allocations; excludes interpreter baseline and non-NumPy native memory).
- Input: synthetic, generated in memory by `make_frame(n, seed=0)`; validation starts from a pandas DataFrame, so CSV parsing time is not included.
